definition: Ontic has a constant candidate domain, a Kripke frame, world-relative ExistsAt, and a separate Causes relation. An inhabitant of the domain is not thereby actual. Causes is left uninterpreted until a concrete model supplies it; no cognitive warrant, per se ordering, act/potency, or total-series explanation follows from its name.
note: Analyst’s explicit reconstruction for the Kant inquiry (#250), not an assertion that the surrogate exhausts the historical concept. Source fidelity and the missing philosophical bridges are discussed in docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
